_comment: Build configuration for every service whose root directory is the repository
root: the API and both cron workers. They share one image (./Dockerfile) and
differ only in start command, which is a per-service setting.
This file is at the repository root because that is where Railway reads
config-as-code from. Two earlier attempts put the equivalent in
backend/railway.json, where it was silently ignored, and a third relied on the
RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH variable, which an explicitly pinned builder overrides.
Config-as-code does not lose that argument: it takes precedence over the
Deliberately build-only. A deploy block here would also apply to the cron
workers, and a health check on a service that starts, does a day's work and
exits would report it down every time it succeeded. Health check, restart
policy and start command are therefore per-service settings, documented in
